cues: Small raw numbers: use the raw-score form.
Awkward means: deviations from an assumed mean.
And set out the table neatly, because the marks are in the columns.
text: Exam tip. Whole-number means: use deviations. Small raw numbers: use the raw-score form. Awkward means: deviations from an assumed mean. And set out the table neatly, because the marks are in the columns.
